title: Proving R.u.t. Lattice Setup Time VS. Einsteinian Photonic Bullets: Replacing C with L_s: Quantitative Mathematical Derivations, e = Mc^2 > e = M*phi, Benchtop Fizeau Protocol, and First-Principles Resolution of 10 Standard Model Anomalies
summary: Standard relativistic physics remains predicated on the Einsteinian postulate that light propagates through a vacuum void as an invariant travel-velocity "photonic bullet" at c = 299,792,458 m/s, governed by E = mc^2. In this paper, we demonstrate that this framework commits a fundamental metrological error by conflating travel velocity across a void with Lattice Setup Time (L_s)--the acoustic "squash time" required to compress elastic inter-granule voids ("marshmallow gaps") in a 10^22 kg/m^3 rigid plenum before engaging the universal acoustic clutch. Under the Rigid Universal Touching Wave…

review.reason: Argues for a lattice-based alternative to light-speed relativity and proposes a benchtop Fizeau test.
